title: Topological Engine Monitor: Persistent Homology-Based Fault Detection in Finite-Time Quantum Engines
summary: The reliable operation of finite-time quantum heat engines is fundamentally limited by control imperfections that induce nonadiabatic phase accumulation and quantum friction, degrading the stability of the thermodynamic cycle. Traditional monitoring relies on energetic observables such as instantaneous cycle work; however, under finite-time driving, these quantities exhibit strong fluctuations, obscuring reliable single-shot fault detection without extensive statistical averaging.
